environment.description: Deployed on an EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2) behind a classic ELB (TCP passthrough mode) in a VPC with default NACLs. The Flask application runs directly via gunicorn on port 8080. Security group allows inbound TCP/443 from 0.0.0.0/0. TLS termination at ELB, forwarded as HTTP to instance. No additional middleware or proxy filtering. SQLite database on local EBS volume.

config.load_balancer: Classic ELB, TCP passthrough, no HTTP-level inspection
config.runtime: gunicorn 21.2.0, Python 3.11, no request filtering middleware
config.database: SQLite 3.40 on local EBS, no query parameterization enforcement
